question: Should CodexBar expose Neuralwatt subscription kWh allowance alongside prepaid USD credits, or intentionally define Neuralwatt as a balance-only provider?
rationale: The API exposes two independently usable quota pools, and source inspection cannot decide whether the product should model both units or deliberately accept a potentially misleading balance-only status.

options.title: Surface Both Quota Pools
options.body: Model prepaid credits and active subscription allowance separately so an account is not shown as exhausted while subscription capacity remains.

options.title: Accept Balance-Only Semantics
options.body: Explicitly approve USD credits as the sole visible contract and document that the displayed exhaustion state does not represent subscription capacity.

options.title: Pause Provider Integration
options.body: Defer the provider until the menu model and runtime proof can support the dual-quota contract confidently.

recommendation.title: Surface Both Quota Pools
recommendation.body: Model prepaid credits and active subscription allowance separately so an account is not shown as exhausted while subscription capacity remains.

likelyOwner.reason: The carried hardening commits and related PR audit show the strongest involvement in both implementation behavior and the unresolved product boundary.
